title: KillCounter
description: A Mod The Tracks Player's Kill Count.
body:
# KillCounter

Keep track of every kill you make in Minecraft!

KillCounter is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that displays your total kills on-screen and provides simple commands to manage your statistics. Whether you're grinding mobs, hunting players, or challenging yourself to beat your personal best, KillCounter makes it easy to monitor your progress.

## Features

✔ Real-time kill tracking

✔ Clean and minimal HUD display

✔ Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

✔ No server-side installation required

✔ Persistent kill statistics

✔ Lightweight and performance-friendly

Commands

### View Kills

/killcounter kills
/kc kills

Displays your current kill count.

### Reset Counter

/killcounter reset
/kc reset

Resets your tracked kill count.

### Help Menu

/killcounter help
/kc help

Shows all available commands.

### HUD

**Your current kill count is displayed in the top-left corner of your screen:**

Example: Kills: 125

The HUD updates automatically whenever you get a kill.

Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Author

Kong
